With an ambitious mission to build a collection of luxurious boutique hotels spanning from North to South Vietnam, the story began in 2022 with the debut of L’HÔTEL du LAC, a four-star jewel nestled in the heart of Hanoi’s Old Quarter. From this inaugural milestone, the HÔTEL du LAC brand swiftly earned its place within the luxury hospitality landscape. L’HÔTEL du LAC distinguished itself through impeccable service, sophisticated interiors, and an art-inspired ambiance, garnering prestigious recognition from global travel platforms including Booking.com, Expedia, and Tripadvisor. Building upon this momentum, Vu Le Management introduced GRAND HÔTEL du LAC , a radiant presence in the Old Quarter that elevated the guest experience with generous spatial design and an integrated lifestyle ecosystem. Its warm reception from both domestic and international travelers paved the way for a confident expansion into southern Vietnam with GRAND HÔTEL du LAC Boutique Saigon , located in the vibrant Bến Thành Ward of Ho Chi Minh City — a defining milestone that fortified the brand’s position within one of the nation’s most dynamic markets. Today, the journey reaches new heights with the unveiling of HÔTEL du LAC SIGNATURE Hanoi , the fourth property in the collection and a resounding statement of elevated distinction. This five-star boutique hotel embodies creative sophistication and an unwavering dedication to excellence, emerging as a new icon of luxury and individuality in the very heart of Vietnam’s capital. Each space at HÔTEL du LAC is envisioned as more than a place to stay, thoughtfully curated to harmonize artistic expression, cultural nuance, and service of exceptional refinement, consistently exceeding expectations. As our journey continues, we remain steadfast in our pursuit of elevated sophistication and distinguished identity, continuing to set new benchmarks on Vietnam’s luxury hospitality landscape.
